title: Vegetable seed planting guide (test stand-in)
body:
TEST STAND-IN, NOT A REAL SOURCE.
This file stands in for Penn State Extension's Vegetable Seed Planting Guide (Master Gardeners of York County) in the
regional coverage prototype, until Penn State answers on reuse. The real chart lists, for each vegetable, whether it is a
cool or warm season crop and its earliest and last sowing dates, set for a 1 May last frost and a 1 October first frost.
Words for search: planting dates, last frost, first frost, sow, transplant, tomatoes, peas, lettuce, Pennsylvania.

title: Cool-season and warm-season vegetables (test stand-in)
body:
TEST STAND-IN, NOT A REAL SOURCE.
This file stands in for Penn State Extension's page Cool-season vs. Warm-season Vegetables in the regional coverage
prototype. The real page explains which crops go in weeks before the last frost and which wait for warm soil.
Words for search: cool season, warm season, frost, plant tomatoes, peas, Pennsylvania.
